Package dev.turboism.sdk.storage

Interface PluginStorage

All Known Implementing Classes:
PluginStorage.Unavailable
public interface PluginStorage
Sandboxed filesystem access granted to a plugin, rooted at the three StorageRoot directories the runtime owns on the plugin's behalf.

Every operation is asynchronous and never throws for an I/O or policy problem: failures are reported inside the returned result as a StorageError. Paths outside the granted roots are rejected by StoragePath construction rather than followed.

  • Method Details

    • readUtf8

      CompletionStage<StorageReadResult<String>> readUtf8(StoragePath path, int maxBytes)
      Reads a file as UTF-8 text.
      Parameters:
      path - file to read, inside a granted root
      maxBytes - ceiling on bytes read; a longer file yields a truncated result rather than an error
      Returns:
      the decoded text, or a StorageError when the file is missing, is not a regular file, or the read fails

    • readBytes

      CompletionStage<StorageReadResult<byte[]>> readBytes(StoragePath path, int maxBytes)
      Reads a file as raw bytes.
      Parameters:
      path - file to read, inside a granted root
      maxBytes - ceiling on bytes read; a longer file yields a truncated result rather than an error
      Returns:
      the bytes, or a StorageError when the read fails; the carried array is cloned on every access, so callers never share a mutable buffer

    • writeUtf8Atomic

      CompletionStage<StorageWriteResult> writeUtf8Atomic(StoragePath path, String content)
      Replaces a file with the given text, encoded as UTF-8, atomically: a concurrent reader observes either the previous or the new content, never a partial write.
      Parameters:
      path - file to write, inside a granted root
      content - text to store
      Returns:
      a written result, or a StorageError such as StorageErrorCode.ATOMIC_REPLACE_UNAVAILABLE when the host filesystem cannot guarantee atomicity

    • writeBytesAtomic

      CompletionStage<StorageWriteResult> writeBytesAtomic(StoragePath path, byte[] content)
      Replaces a file with the given bytes atomically.
      Parameters:
      path - file to write, inside a granted root
      content - bytes to store
      Returns:
      a written result, or a StorageError describing why the atomic replace could not be completed

    • list

      CompletionStage<StorageListResult> list(StoragePath directory, int maxEntries)
      Lists the immediate children of a directory; the listing does not recurse.
      Parameters:
      directory - directory to enumerate, inside a granted root
      maxEntries - ceiling on returned entries; exceeding it produces a truncated listing rather than an error
      Returns:
      the entries, or a StorageError; a failed listing carries no entries and is never marked truncated

    • copy

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> copy(StoragePath source, StoragePath target, boolean replaceExisting)
      Copies a file or directory to another location under a granted root.
      Parameters:
      source - existing path to copy from
      target - path to create
      replaceExisting - when false, an existing target fails with StorageErrorCode.ALREADY_EXISTS instead of being overwritten
      Returns:
      whether anything changed, plus the error when it did not

    • moveAtomic

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> moveAtomic(StoragePath source, StoragePath target, boolean replaceExisting)
      Moves a path atomically. A move between two different StorageRoots cannot be made atomic and is reported as StorageErrorCode.CROSS_ROOT_ATOMIC_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED.
      Parameters:
      source - existing path to move from
      target - path to move to
      replaceExisting - when false, an existing target fails with StorageErrorCode.ALREADY_EXISTS
      Returns:
      whether anything changed, plus the error when it did not

    • delete

      CompletionStage<StorageMutationResult> delete(StoragePath path, boolean recursive)
      Deletes a file or directory.
      Parameters:
      path - path to remove
      recursive - when false, a non-empty directory is not removed; when true, a removal that completes only in part is reported as changed with a StorageErrorCode.PARTIAL_DELETE error
      Returns:
      whether anything changed, plus the error when it did not
